_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Adds propose_leave_decision as the single governed entry point for a propose-only time-off recommendation: it combines leave guards, the organization's WWWD decision gate, and an auditable AgentActionProposal without changing LeaveRequest status. Existing staffing coverage is read-only and generic proposal execution would bypass the leave-specific human approval boundary, so neither can carry this contract. BI-4D030159.

registry.packFiles.reason: Adds one focused leave-decision pack so the permanent tool definition, propose-only authority metadata, and existing grant requirements remain one bounded MCP contract. Reusing the staffing pack would mix read-only coverage with a business-decision proposal side effect and obscure the human-only leave authority boundary. BI-4D030159.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
